column3: With respect to the West Memorial Place Mortgage Loan (7.6%), the borrower sponsors have sponsored other real estate projects that have been the subject of mortgage loan defaults, foreclosure proceedings and/or deeds-in-lieu of foreclosure, including a foreclosure in 2022 on a mortgage loan secured by an office property in Houston, a deed-in-lieu in 2024 with respect to a mortgage loan secured by another office property in Houston, and a foreclosure in 2024 on a mortgage loan secured by an office property in Santa Clara.
